mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 signals supply chain disruption that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
